name: What factors influence the cost of drywall and finish work in a room addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of drywall and finish work in a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Room addition drywall costs depend on room dimensions, ceiling height, chosen finish level, and custom architectural features. Vaulted or tray ceilings require specialized scaffolding and additional labor compared to flat eight-foot ceilings. Choosing a completely smooth Level 5 finish increases labor costs over a standard sprayed orange peel texture because it requires skimming the entire wall face. Additional finish details, such as wrapping drywall around custom window returns or integrating curved arches, also add labor hours to the finishing phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total square footage, ceiling heights, chosen finish level, and architectural details like arches, recessed niches, or custom window wraps.
